name: AIO Sandbox (agent-infra)
summary: All-in-one agent sandbox in a single Docker container: browser (VNC/CDP), shell, file system, VS Code Server, Jupyter and MCP sharing one file system.
description: Run `ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox` and the container serves API docs, a VNC browser, VS Code Server and MCP services at `/mcp` on port 8080, so a file downloaded in the browser is immediately available to the shell and code tools. Set `SANDBOX_API_KEY` to require a key on every service (sent as `X-AIO-API-Key`, a bearer token or `?api_key=`); without it the services stay open, so the README binds to 127.0.0.1 and says to keep port 8080 private behind a reverse proxy in the cloud. Pin release tags for reproducible deployments.

agent_access.notes: Self-hosted. MCP at http://localhost:8080/mcp; enable SANDBOX_API_KEY before exposing it.
